P.text: Vault is in production with USDM minted 1:1 against USDC and PM is activated on the Vault's L1 account; the Vault has a hedge or spot position and HyperLiquid's PM auto-borrow triggers due to adverse price movement, so the L1 account shows spot USDC = +X and 0x811 borrow.value = +X with real net assets unchanged.
P.evidence_quote: Vault is in production with USDM minted 1:1 against USDC. PM is activated on the Vault's L1 account.

I.text: Solvency accounting must include both the borrow and supply legs of the 0x811 BORROW_LEND_USER_STATE, subtracting borrow.value from backing so reported backing equals real net assets.
I.evidence_quote: For solvency accounting, both legs matter: a user with `supply.value=60k` and `borrow.value=40k` has net BLP exposure of `+20k`, not `+60k`.

V.text: PrecompileReader.suppliedBalance reads only the fourth uint64 slot, discarding borrow.basis and borrow.value, so _readL1Backing never subtracts borrow.value and totalBackingSigned() overstates real net assets by the borrow amount; phantom surplus passes Gate 3 and settle accepts unbacked yield, displacing principal.
V.evidence_quote: `borrow.value` is never subtracted. Once an auto-borrow triggers, `totalBackingSigned()` overstates real net assets by exactly the borrow amount.
